content:
[Verse 1 - practice]
@voice af_heart
(break 2)
(slot 4)
The pace is syllables a second,
Three and a half, the middle reckoned,
The same voice slows to fit the feeling,
A calm track wide, a touch of healing.
Ease it down when the lights are low,
Let every word land nice and slow,
No hurry in a quiet room,
The mood decides, and not the tune.

[Verse 2 - driving]
@voice am_michael
(slot 2)
Now the engine's turning,
Now the road is burning,
Ten percent ahead,
That's how numbers run.
Ten tracks out of twelve,
Check the count yourself,
Not double, not a sprint,
A lean, a little hint.
Speed it up, stay clear,
Every word in place,
Driving, never blurred,
You still catch each word.

[Hook]
@voice bm_george
(slot auto)
Slow it down when the night is still,
(be still!)
Speed it up when the engine turns,
Match the pace to the thing you feel,
(you feel!)
Ten percent is all it earns.
(break 2)

[Verse 3 - wrong gear]
@voice am_michael
(slot 2)
I'm rushing, I'm the hurry,
Each line a little blurry,
A lullaby, I'm sprinting,
A lullaby, I'm sprinting,
Words are out and scattered,
Like no feeling mattered.
One gear for each story,
Sad ones and the glory.

[Verse 4 - the fix]
@voice af_heart
(slot auto)
So ask the song what kind of day it's having,
Then pick a pace, no grabbing and no stabbing,
Hold it even.
A calm one sits around three and a half,
A driving one adds ten percent, not half.
Same voice, same breath, same mouth, the same old tongue,
The only thing I changed in here was how fast it was sung.
Stay small.

[Hook - last time]
@voice bm_george
Slow it down when the night is still,
(be still!)
Speed it up when the engine turns,
Match the pace to the thing you feel,
(you feel!)
Ten percent is all it earns.
Calm or driving, same voice, same skill,
Calm or driving, same voice, same skill.
(break 2)

[Outro]
@voice af_heart
(slot 4)
Calm or driving, same voice, same skill,
Slow it down when the night is still.

made_with.tool: lyric sheet written in a Claude Code session; rendered locally with sing.py (audio kept outside the repository)

redaction.method: by-value scan with verify.py: no credentials, hosts or addresses
